subject: Vendor risk questionnaire: kickoff & clarifying questions
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@novaretail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor risk questionnaire: kickoff & clarifying questions

Hi Jamie — great speaking earlier. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we have everything in one place.

Recap (30 min demo + security portion):
- We walked through Redwood Inference hosted API and Dedicated options; Novaretail will primarily evaluate hosted API for the initial pilot.
- Main security topics: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, data residency, and vendor questionnaire workflow.

What we can provide this week:
- A partially prefilled SIG/CAIQ (PDF) to accelerate your review — attached (redwood_sig_prefill_initial.pdf).
- A data flow diagram and list of subprocessors (can provide redacted names if preferred).
- Timeline note: Redwood is in the final stages of a SOC 2 Type II audit; expected completion mid-March 2027.

Clarifying questions for your team (quick bullets):
1) Which questionnaire do you prefer we complete? SIG Lite, full SIG, CAIQ (OWASP/CSA) or your custom spreadsheet?
2) Do you need a redacted SOC 2 report or will a SOC 2 pre-audit statement suffice for procurement? Any NDA required to share the report?
3) Is HIPAA in-scope for the pilot, or are we focused only on PCI/GDPR/data residency controls?
4) For encryption: do you need customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for hosted, or would Redwood-managed KMS be acceptable for the pilot?
5) Preferred format for the prefill: PDF (quick), or an XLSX prefill that maps to your columns (better for automation)?

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm questionnaire preference + any immediate blockers.
- We provide the spreadsheet prefill + subprocessors + data flow diagram by EOD Monday if you want the XLSX.
- Schedule a 45-minute technical review w/ your infra/security engineers early next week (I can do Mon/Tue mornings PST).

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_sig_prefill_initial.pdf (PDF, 38KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0136

From: Jamie Li <jamie.li@novaretail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaretail Security <security@novaretail.com>, Edwards, Legal <edwards@novaretail.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor risk questionnaire: kickoff & clarifying questions

Thanks Markus — good summary. A few items from our side so we can scope the ask properly.

Quick answers:
- We generally prefer SIG Lite for a first pass, but we may push a few additional controls into a custom spreadsheet if the pilot expands.
- We will need a copy of your SOC 2 Type II when available. Redacted is fine but we’ll likely ask for the actual report under an NDA for higher tiers.
- HIPAA: the pilot will not process PHI initially, but our compliance team needs confirmation that Redwood has HIPAA-related controls and can sign a BAA if the scope expands.

A few clarifying questions for Redwood:
- Can you confirm encryption at rest details (algorithm and key management) for hosted vs. dedicated deployments?
- Where are audit logs retained (how long) and who has access?
- Please provide a current list of subprocessors and whether any subprocessors are hosted in non-US regions.
- For the SIG/CAIQ prefill: we’d prefer an XLSX mapping to our columns (we attach our template).

I’ve attached our questionnaire (Novaretail_Security_Q_v1.xlsx) — please let us know if you need a contact from legal or procurement on our side (I copied Edwards).

Thanks,
Jamie Li
Security Program Manager
Novaretail
jamie.li@novaretail.com

[Attachment: Novaretail_Security_Q_v1.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor risk questionnaire: kickoff & clarifying questions

On Sat, Jan 30, 2027 at 5:03 PM Jamie Li <jamie.li@novaretail.com> wrote:
> Thanks Markus — good summary. A few items from our side so we can scope the ask properly.

Hi Jamie — thanks for the quick replies and for sending the template. Below are direct answers and deliverables we can provide immediately.

Direct answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood is actively completing a Type II engagement; final auditor sign-off is targeted for 2027-03-15. We can produce a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. We do not have a SOC 3 at this time.
- HIPAA: controls relevant to HIPAA are implemented (access controls, encryption, logging, BA pathways). Redwood is willing to discuss a BAA if Novaretail requires PHI handling beyond the pilot.
- Encryption: AES-256 for data at rest. Key management: for Dedicated or Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS or HSM integration). For Redwood-hosted (multi-tenant) customers we use Redwood-managed KMS by default; we can evaluate BYOK options on a case-by-case enterprise contract.
- Audit logs and retention: platform operational logs retained for 90 days by default; security- and audit-sensitive logs can be retained longer under an enterprise agreement — we can provide a retention options matrix. Access is limited to SRE/security roles and is logged via our IAM and SIEM (we can provide an access matrix).
- Subprocessors: we will provide the current subprocessors list and indicate region (US/EU/APAC). For vendor names that are sensitive we can provide category-level info and sign a mutual NDA if you need vendor-level detail sooner.

Deliverables we will send by EOD Monday:
- XLSX prefill mapped to your Novaretail_Security_Q_v1.xlsx (attachment: redwood_prefill_SIG_spreadsheet.xlsx).
- Data flow diagram (attached: redwood_dataflow_v1.svg) and a short narrative describing token handling and retention.
- A redacted SOC 2 package ready to deliver under NDA (we’ll need your preferred NDA or we can send our mutual NDA).

Scheduling: we suggest a 45-minute technical review with our infra/security lead and product engineer. Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon Feb 1, 10:00–10:45 AM
- Tue Feb 2, 09:00–09:45 AM
Please let us know which works for Novaretail; we’ll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_prefill_SIG_spreadsheet.xlsx (Excel, 46KB)], [Attachment: redwood_dataflow_v1.svg (SVG, 12KB)]

Best,
Camila Reyes
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
